hook.visual: Cover frame with huge 'HOW TF IS THIS LEGAL' text, then a cut to him slowly pulling his glasses down in disbelief under the same line with a flushed emoji.

beats.what: Thumbnail-style cover: shocked face and huge white headline.
Glasses-pull reaction shot holding the 'How tf is this legal' line, no speech.
Phone-filmed laptop: a finger points at the Luma Uni-1 URL with a link emoji.
Sign up and grab the API key.
Same move on the Claude platform URL.
The built tool: 'turn any image into a viral machine'; upload any viral image.
Tool output: it analyzes and generates a new version.
CTA: comment LUMA to get prompts and links.

why_it_works: Wordless reaction (slow glasses pull) under a 'how is this legal' line is a pattern interrupt that promises a secret before any explanation.
One step per cut, about 2 s each (26.4 cuts/min), with a single short on-screen line, so it reads on mute.
Comment-keyword CTA trades the full prompt for engagement.
weaknesses: No voice and phone-filmed laptop footage: the UI is shaky and hard to read.
Likes far outpace comments (5) and shares (30), so the comment-keyword CTA barely converted.
The 'legal' claim is clickbait the steps never address.
for_robert: Steal the wordless reaction beat: open with a 2 s silent double-take (yours or Fred's) under one shocked line before you speak.
